note: Every row is one engine call on a freshly built unit at level 20, holding the item named by `item` (-1 is nothing held). The held item id lives in the unit's form column, so `hasSourceHeldItem(n)` is the same test the engine makes for a form status, and a pet holds at most one item. `items` is the row the engine resolves for each id plus the raw columns an effect reads, so a parameter index is measured instead of assumed. The projection rows run `clearBuffs()` first on a unit with no status, which is the only public way to reach the engine's stat re-projection. Draws are recorded per label so a roll the port does not draw, or draws in the wrong order, is a disagreement rather than a guess.
